verdict.rationale: Elicit lets users set an effort slider (Fastest to Smartest) before sending a query, which directly controls depth/effort, and Research Agent sessions can be iterated on and steered mid-conversation via follow-up prompts and column additions. However, there's no evidence of adjusting scope/effort mid-run while it executes (only before sending), nor granular controls over search scope/breadth beyond the effort slider. missing for 10: evidence of changing effort/depth while a run is actively executing, explicit scope controls (e.g., source count/breadth limits), and independent verification that the effort slider meaningfully changes output depth.
